description_en: Creates an image synchronization rule for an image repository

kebab_example: aliyun cr create-repo-sync-rule --instance-id cri-hpdfkc6utbaq0000 --namespace-name ns1 --repo-name repo1 --target-region-id cn-shanghai --target-instance-id cri-ibxs3piklys30000 --target-namespace-name ns1 --target-repo-name repo1 --repo-name-filter .0 --tag-filter .0 --sync-scope REPO --sync-rule-name rule --sync-trigger PASSIVE --target-user-id 12645940000 --link-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en: The namespace name of the source instance
parameters.name: namespace_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the image repository in the source instance
parameters.name: repo_name

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the destination instance
parameters.name: target_region_id

parameters.help_en: The namespace name of the destination instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例命名空间名称
parameters.name: target_namespace_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the image repository in the destination instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例镜像仓库名称
parameters.name: target_repo_name

parameters.help_en:
The regular expression that is used to filter repositories.

This parameter is valid only when SyncScope is set to `NAMESPACE`
parameters.help_zh:
仓库过滤规则。
该参数仅在同步类型 SyncScope 是 `NAMESPACE` 时有效
parameters.name: repo_name_filter

parameters.help_en: The regular expression that is used to filter image tags
parameters.name: tag_filter

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization scope. Valid values:

`REPO`: synchronizes the image tags in an image repository that meet the synchronization rule.
`NAMESPACE`: synchronizes the image tags in a namespace that meet the synchronization rule
parameters.help_zh:
同步类型，取值：

`REPO`：按照镜像仓库同步。

`NAMESPACE`：按照命名空间同步
parameters.name: sync_scope

parameters.help_en: The name of the image synchronization rule
parameters.name: sync_rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The mode of triggering the synchronization rule. Valid values:

`INITIATIVE`: manually triggers the synchronization rule.
`PASSIVE`: automatically triggers the synchronization rule
parameters.help_zh:
触发同步动作，取值：

`INITIATIVE`：手动触发。
 
`PASSIVE`：自动触发
parameters.name: sync_trigger

parameters.help_en:
The user ID (UID) of the account to which the destination instance belongs.

If you synchronize images across accounts, you must use the UID
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例所在的账号UID。

跨账号同步镜像时，需要使用账号UID
parameters.name: target_user_id
